links.comparator_used: Accepting all automated segmentations without uncertainty-based triage (all cases analysed as output)
links.outcome: Volume-category agreement with ground truth, and detection of poor segmentations (Dice <0.60)
links.effect: U_clot AUC 0.89 for poor segmentation; threshold 0.323 gave 90% sensitivity and 96% NPV; 60% of cases accepted automatically; volume-category agreement improved from 66% (κ=0.49) to 83% (κ=0.69)
links.tradeoff: Only 60% of cases were accepted automatically, so about 40% of cases are flagged for manual review or correction.
links.quote: As a univariate predictor of poor segmentation, U_clot achieved an AUC of 0.89; the optimal threshold (0.323) yielded 90% sensitivity and 96% negative predictive value, allowing 60% of cases to be accepted automatically while improving volume-category agreement from 66% (κ=0.49) to 83% (κ=0.69).
